knowledge_gaps: The execution failure has no traceback or failing-stage description. Contract testing is a reasonable next step, but the report cannot establish that it addresses the actual failure.

Candidate-permutation equivariance cannot detect every candidate-ID error: a scorer using a consistently incorrect item mapping may still pass. Add an independent per-item scoring reference that includes the jointly trained lexical residual, and compare batched, singleton and chunked scoring where supported.

Causal-prefix checks cover log2feats but may miss future information entering through scoring-side state or the lexical residual. Test aligned positive-target logits through the complete scoring path as well as intermediate features.

Numerical tolerances, batch and position caps, mutation counts, nonfinite handling and detection denominators are unspecified. Failed baseline controls must remain visible as failures; mutation results relying on those controls should be marked uninterpretable.

The pseudocode traverses train_loader twice. A one-shot iterator may be exhausted, while another traversal may advance sampler or worker RNG states that restoring global RNG does not repair. Reuse a bounded cached batch sample and document loader-state limitations.

The proposed audit does not verify that working/predict.py reproduces the trained checkpoint's scores, readout and lexical residual. An end-to-end parity check using public training contexts would address checkpoint and embedded-predictor consistency.

Originality 4/10 is plausible, but potential 8/10 is speculative without fault-detection results. Difficulty 3/10 may underestimate production-path integration, reversible mutations and state restoration. Historical sensitivity results also need explicit provenance because the current execution failed.
